lines.beaver: 요즘 무슨 생각을 해요? 얼굴이 좀 슬퍼 보여요.
lines.beaver_en: What are you thinking about lately? You look a bit sad.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum museun saenggageul haeyo? eolguri jom seulpeo boyeoyo.
lines.learner: 할머니 생각을 많이 해요. 마음이 아파요.
lines.en: I think about my grandma a lot. My heart hurts.
lines.roman: halmeoni saenggageul mani haeyo. maeumi apayo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you miss your grandma a lot?
lines.en: Yes, I really miss my grandma.

lines.beaver_en: What memories do you have with her?
lines.en: My grandma raised me all by herself.

lines.beaver_en: When did you last see her?
lines.learner: 서울에 온 후 못 만났어요. 너무 아쉬워요.
lines.en: I haven't seen her since I came to Seoul. It's such a shame.
lines.roman: seoure on hu mon mannasseoyo. neomu aswiwoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 할머니께 하고 싶은 말이 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Then is there something you want to tell her?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom halmeonikke hago sipeun mari isseoyo?
lines.en: I really want to tell her thank you.

lines.beaver: 편지를 써 보세요. 마음이 편해질 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Try writing her a letter. You'll feel better.
lines.beaver_roman: pyeonjireul sseo boseyo. maeumi pyeonhaejil geoyeyo.
lines.learner: 좋은 생각이에요. 먼저 편지를 써 볼게요.
lines.en: Good idea. I'll write a letter first.
lines.roman: joeun saenggagieyo. meonjeo pyeonjireul sseo bolgeyo.

lines.en: Found it! Here's a photo of my grandma.

lines.learner: 네, 할머니도 지금 제 생각을 하실 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, I bet she's thinking of me right now too.
lines.roman: ne, halmeonido jigeum je saenggageul hasil geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 사실 저도 고향에 계신 엄마가 그리워요.
lines.beaver_en: Actually, I miss my mom back home too.
lines.beaver_roman: sasil jeodo gohyange gyesin eommaga geuriwoyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 지영 씨도 오늘 엄마께 전화해 보세요.
lines.en: Then try calling your mom today, Jiyeong.
lines.roman: geureom jiyeong ssido oneul eommakke jeonhwahae boseyo.

lines.beaver_en: I will. Thanks for sharing your story.
lines.learner: 제 말을 들어 줘서 고마워요. 나중에 또 봐요.
lines.en: Thanks for listening to me. See you later.
lines.roman: je mareul deureo jwoseo gomawoyo. najunge tto bwayo.
